// ===================================================== // ACT_Positioning: drive X and Y to their targets // ===================================================== // An axis stops for good when it is within the tolerance (bPosXReached / bPosYReached), // so it does not hunt back and forth if the motor coasts a little. IF bDriveX AND NOT bPosXReached THEN IF nPosX < nTargetX - nTolerance THEN M2_Forward := TRUE; // towards rack END_IF IF nPosX > nTargetX + nTolerance THEN M2_Back := TRUE; // towards conveyor END_IF IF NOT M2_Forward AND NOT M2_Back THEN bPosXReached := TRUE; END_IF END_IF
IF bDriveY AND NOT bPosYReached THEN IF nPosY < nTargetY - nTolerance THEN M3_Down := TRUE; // larger Y = further down END_IF IF nPosY > nTargetY + nTolerance THEN M3_Up := TRUE; // smaller Y = further up END_IF IF NOT M3_Down AND NOT M3_Up THEN bPosYReached := TRUE; END_IF END_IF
// S75: Y in position (M3 off), waits for X nStep := 75;
// S76: X in position (M2 off), waits for Y nStep := 76;
// S83: Y in position (M3 off), waits for X nStep := 83;
// S82: X in position (M2 off), waits for Y nStep := 82;
// S88 = S70 Exit step: home again. Homing returns to S70 because bAuto is still TRUE. nStep := 88;
